title: Moment Restrictions for Dyadic Network Formation Models with Nontransferable Utility
abstract: arXiv:2609.12545v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper investigates the construction of moment restrictions in dyadic network formation models with unobserved individual heterogeneity under nontransferable utility. Using observed links and covariates from five-node pentads, we construct moment restrictions that do not depend on individual fixed effects. For a broad class of covariate specifications, the construction is minimal in the sense that it uses the least possible number of nodes and dyads. Based on these moment restrictions, we propose the pentad-GMM estimator. We establish asymptotic normality of the pentad-GMM estimator in dense, sparse, and ultra-sparse network regimes, with regime-specific convergence rates and asymptotic variances. These results provide a basis for inference across all three regimes. To make our method computationally efficient, we develop an algorithm that reduces the computational cost of the estimator from na\"ive \(O(N^5)\) to \(O(N^3)\). We apply

translated_title: 不可转移效用下二方组网络形成模型的矩约束
translated_abstract: 本文研究了在不可转移效用下，具有不可观测个体异质性的二方组网络形成模型中矩约束的构建。利用五节点五元组中观测到的连边和协变量，我们构建了不依赖于个体固定效应的矩约束。对于一大类协变量设定，该构建在意义上是最小的，即使用了尽可能少的节点和二方组。基于这些矩约束，我们提出了五元组广义矩估计量。我们建立了该估计量在稠密、稀疏和超稀疏三种网络情形下的渐近正态性，并给出了各情形特定的收敛速度和渐近方差。这些结果为三种情形下的统计推断提供了基础。为了使我们的方法在计算上更加高效，我们开发了一种算法，将估计量的计算成本从朴素的 O(N^5) 降低到 O(N^3)。
tldr: 本文针对具有个体固定效应和不可转移效用的二方组网络形成模型，构建了不依赖固定效应的最小矩约束，提出五元组GMM估计量并证明其在稠密、稀疏和超稀疏三种网络情形下的渐近正态性，同时开发算法将计算成本从 O(N^5) 降至 O(N^3)。
en_tdlr: This paper constructs minimal moment restrictions free of fixed effects for dyadic network formation models with nontransferable utility, proposes a pentad-GMM estimator with established asymptotic normality across dense, sparse, and ultra-sparse network regimes, and develops an algorithm reducing computational cost from O(N^5) to O(N^3).
